# JurisTech Solutions - Complete Platform Documentation
## Version 11.0.0 | Updated: October 2026
## URL: https://www.juristech.solutions

# ABOUT
JurisTech Solutions is the leading sovereign AI legal technology platform for the MENA region, the United States, Europe, and Asia. Founded by Dr. Mohammad Mustafa (Senior Counsel & AI Risk Architect), the platform serves enterprises, law firms, investment consortiums, and businesses across 50+ countries.

Mission: Deliver sovereign, institutional-grade AI contract audit, clause redlining, and cross-border regulatory compliance while maintaining 100% client confidentiality and zero public training on user data.

# CORE PLATFORM CAPABILITIES

## 1. AI Contract Analysis
URL: /contracts
Description: Upload any contract (PDF, Word, or raw text) for instant AI audit. The engine identifies:
- Risky clauses, unfair terms, and unilateral termination provisions
- Unlimited liability traps and uncapped indemnification
- Penalty clauses exceeding statutory legal ceilings
- Governing law mismatches and unadvisable dispute resolution venues
- Force majeure and pandemic/cyber risk coverage gaps
Output: Granular report with 0-100 risk score, highlighted hazardous clauses, and suggested compliant redlines in Arabic, English, German, Turkish, Chinese, and French.

## 2. Legal Risk Radar
URL: /risk
Description: Comprehensive multi-axis risk scoring system assessing contracts against specific local statutes:
- Overall risk score (0-100, color-coded green/amber/red)
- Breakdown across 4 primary risk vectors: Financial, Operational, IP, and Regulatory
- Severity classification: Critical, High, Medium, Low
- Actionable statutory remediation recommendations
- Exportable executive audit reports (PDF & Microsoft Word .docx)

## 3. Sovereign Institutional Contract Templates (101 Master Contracts)
URL: /templates
Description: 101 professionally crafted, legally vetted institutional master contracts across 10 strategic sectors and 15 jurisdictions:
- Technology, SaaS, and Cloud Infrastructure (SLAs, EULAs, Master Services)
- Corporate, M&A, Private Equity, and Joint Ventures
- International Trade, Supply Chain, and Distribution (UNCITRAL / Incoterms 2020)
- Banking, FinTech, and Structured Finance
- Real Estate, EPC, and Infrastructure (FIDIC aligned)
- Employment, Executive Retention, and Non-Compete
- Intellectual Property, Patent Licensing, and Technology Transfer
- Healthcare, Pharma, and Biotech Compliance
- Energy, CleanTech, and Utilities
- Commercial Agency and Franchise Agreements

## 4. Power of Attorney (POA) Smart Library
URL: /poa-library
Description: Comprehensive repository of verified Power of Attorney instruments for GCC and international jurisdictions. Includes general POA, commercial litigation POA, corporate management POA, and real estate disposition POA with statutory notarization guidance.

## 5. Contract Negotiation Studio
URL: /negotiation
Description: AI-assisted negotiation environment featuring:
- Clause-by-clause position tracking
- Balanced counter-proposal formulation
- Certified SHA-256 digital e-signatures
- Complete audit trail and version diff comparison

## 6. Deal Shield 360™
URL: /deal-shield
Description: Cross-border transaction security and statutory clash simulator. Analyzes multi-party deal terms against diverging legal frameworks (e.g., Saudi Civil Transactions Law vs. Delaware DGCL vs. English Common Law), highlighting irreconcilable clauses before signing.

## 7. Corporate Structuring & Articles of Association AI
URL: /corporate-structuring
Description: AI constitutional engineering for business entities:
- Automated drafting of Articles of Association (عقد التأسيس) for KSA LLCs, UAE Free Zone & Mainland entities, Delaware LLCs/C-Corps, and UK Private Limited Companies
- Shareholder governance agreements and board voting mandates
- Administrative and financial signing authority structuring

## 8. Sovereign Encrypted Document Vault
URL: /vault
Description: Bank-grade AES-GCM 256-bit encrypted document repository with client-side zero-knowledge architecture, automated expiration tracking, and multi-tenant isolation.

## 9. AI Legal Advisor (Ask Juris)
URL: /chat (or /ai-advisor)
Description: 24/7 sovereign legal consultation chatbot grounded in legal statutes and precedents across 15+ legal frameworks.

## 10. Enterprise Compliance Audit
URL: /enterprise-audit
Description: Comprehensive corporate governance audit reviewing company-wide contractual exposure against US SEC, EU GDPR, EU AI Act, Saudi PDPL, and UNCITRAL mandates.

# TARGETED REGIONAL LEGAL INTELLIGENCE & KEYWORDS

## 1. Gulf & Middle East (GCC / MENA)
- **Jurisdictions**: Saudi Arabia (Civil Transactions Law 1444H / Royal Decree M/191, Companies Law M/132), UAE (Federal Decree-Law No. 50/2022, DIFC, ADGM), Egypt, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan.
- **Key Terms**: فحص العقود بالذكاء الاصطناعي, كشف البنود التعسفية, نظام المعاملات المدنية السعودي, صياغة عقد التأسيس, تدقيق الشرط الجزائي, حوكمة الشركات, محامي ذكاء اصطناعي.

## 2. United States & International Common Law
- **Jurisdictions**: Delaware General Corporation Law (DGCL), Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), New York Commercial Division, English Common Law.
- **Key Terms**: AI Contract Review, Legal Risk Scoring, Unlimited Liability Traps, Indemnification Caps, M&A Due Diligence, SaaS Master Service Agreement, Delaware Articles of Incorporation.

## 3. Germany & DACH Region (Deutschland, Österreich, Schweiz)
- **Jurisdictions**: Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), Handelsgesetzbuch (HGB), GmbH-Gesetz, Aktiengesetz, DSGVO / EU GDPR, EU AI Act.
- **Key Terms**: KI Vertragsanalyse, AGB Prüfung Künstliche Intelligenz, Haftungsbeschränkung Vertrag, Gesellschaftsvertrag Entwurf, Rechtliche Risikoprüfung, Legal Tech Software Deutschland.

## 4. Türkiye (Turkish Market)
- **Jurisdictions**: Türk Ticaret Kanunu (TTK - Kanun No. 6102), Türk Borçlar Kanunu (TBK - Kanun No. 6098), KVKK.
- **Key Terms**: Yapay Zeka Sözleşme Analizi, Hukuki Risk Tespiti, Şirket Ana Sözleşmesi Hazırlama, Ağırlaştırılmış Cezai Şart İncelemesi, Ticari Sözleşmeler Hukuk Teknolojisi.

## 5. China & East Asia (中国市场)
- **Jurisdictions**: 中华人民共和国民法典 (PRC Civil Code), 中华人民共和国公司法 (Company Law), UNCITRAL Model Law, CISG.
- **Key Terms**: AI合同审查, 商业合同风险评估, 涉外经济合同, 违约金条款法律合规, 公司章程起草AI, 跨国并购尽职调查.
